# StackedByDan

> StackedByDan is the freelance web development business of Daniel Golding, a UK-based full stack developer and Cloudflare specialist. He builds fast, hand-coded websites for UK small businesses and sole traders (fixed prices from £249) and builds, fixes and migrates applications on Cloudflare Workers, Pages, D1, KV, R2 and Durable Objects for businesses and development teams.

Key facts:

- Person: Daniel Golding ("Dan"), full stack developer, Head of IT Services in his day job, 5+ years' experience.
- Location: United Kingdom (GMT/BST). Works remotely with clients across the UK and Europe.
- Contact: hello@stackedbydan.dev or the form at https://stackedbydan.dev/#contact. Replies within 24 hours.
- No WordPress, Wix, Squarespace or page builders. Every site is hand-coded in HTML, CSS and JavaScript and hosted on Cloudflare. Clients own the code outright.

## Website packages (one-off, GBP)

- Starter, £249: 1 to 3 pages, mobile-ready, SEO-ready, Cloudflare hosting setup, domain and DNS help, Google index submission. Typically 5 to 7 days.
- Growth, £499: 4 to 7 pages, contact form with email delivery, analytics setup, more complex layouts. Around 2 weeks.
- Business, £999: 8 to 15 pages, advanced SEO and structured data, sitemap and robots.txt, content management and handover documentation.
- Optional monthly support: £25/month (hosting management and uptime monitoring) or £49/month (content updates, priority support and security patches).
- Privacy policy, cookie policy, terms and a cookie banner are included free on every build.

## Cloudflare development

- Workers APIs, webhooks, form handlers, authentication (JWT, TOTP), rate limiting, Cron Triggers and email sending from Workers.
- Data: D1 (SQL), KV, R2 object storage and Durable Objects for real-time collaboration.
- Cloudflare Pages and Pages Functions, Workers static assets, custom domains and Git-based CI/CD.
- Migrations to Cloudflare from WordPress, shared hosting, Netlify or Vercel, including DNS, 301 redirects, SSL and email records.
- Security: Turnstile, Content Security Policy and security headers, WAF and rate-limit rules.
- Pricing: fixed-price quote per job, usually within 24 hours.
